function.name: avatar_stage
function.description: Stage the avatar's next spoken reply. Select a cached text embedding to steer live Ardy body generation, plus a subtle facial expression. This does not play a prerecorded animation. This queues settings; nothing plays until your final spoken answer is complete.

tail_seconds.description: Body motion after the voice ends. Range: 0.5 to 3.0.

strength.description: Expression intensity; keep subtle so LAM can articulate speech. Range: 0.0 to 0.75.

cue_seconds.description: Delay before voice and face, measured from the start of the body track. Range: 0.0 to 3.0.
